# Repository hygiene and generated files

The source repository intentionally versions only files required to build,
test, document, audit, or demonstrate the packages from a clean checkout.

## Intentionally versioned generated files

- `Documentation/APIBaselines/*.json` are generated by
  `Scripts/update_api_baselines.sh`. They are review artifacts used to reject
  accidental source-breaking API changes.
- `.swiftpm/xcode/xcshareddata/xcschemes/*.xcscheme` and
  `.swiftpm/xcode/xcshareddata/xctestplans/*.xctestplan` are shared Xcode
  integration files. They are deterministic project configuration, not user
  state.
- `P5Demo/P5Demo.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` and its shared workspace metadata
  define the historical native sample application. User schemes, breakpoints,
  workspace UI state, indexes, build products, and Derived Data are excluded.
- `Tests/ML5Tests/Resources/BundledModel.mlmodel` is a deliberately committed
  source fixture, not a locally compiled `.mlmodelc` product.

## Never versioned

SwiftPM `.build`, locally resolved dependency state, Xcode `xcuserdata`,
`DerivedData`, index stores, result bundles, profiler traces, coverage raw data,
credentials, `.netrc`, and operating-system metadata remain ignored. CI starts
from a checkout that contains none of them.

Run `python3 Scripts/check_repository_hygiene.py` to reject tracked editor,
credential, build, and Xcode user-state files and to confirm that required
shared schemes, test plans, API baselines, and privacy manifests exist.
